body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung presented ‘F500’ dubbed ‘Ultra Video’, a new addition of its premium product lineup Ultra Slim mobile phone series during CES 2007.
While sharing the same features and ‘sweeping’ US with the F300 dual-face Ultra music, the F500 can also be used as a portable mobile TV to play various multimedia contents with swiveling LCD.

Both of the F300 and F500 have a totally different design on each side with 2.1-inch and 2.3-inch LCD respectively. It supports DivX codec and play back of various file formats including MPEG4, H.264, WMV, and AVI. It also features microSD card slot and ‘sweeping’ UI that you need to press the button with a quick smooth move to navigate. The internal memory capacity is not decided yet.
It is expected to be available in Korea, Europe and USA market in February or early March, 2007.
